ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction. NVDA delivered a blowout Q2 beat ($96.2B revenue, +4.1-4.6% above consensus) and guided FY2028 revenue growth of ~70% — nearly 2x the ~35-45% street expectation — yet the stock sold off 4.6% on Aug 28 driven by Warsh's hawkish macro tone rather than any fundamental deterioration. At ~$217.55 vs a consensus analyst PT of $323.42 and trading at only 25x forward earnings despite 106% YoY revenue growth, this is a classic beat-and-dip setup. All 6 runs flagged options (call spreads or cash-secured puts) as strongly preferred over outright stock given the FOMC Sep 15-16 rate-hike overhang.
